brewing.notes: A safe starting point for dark tea: rinse once, boiling water, or simmer it the traditional way.

description:
An osmanthus-scented brick tea, a local product of Xian'an District in Hubei.

Recipes for a flavoured or scented tea vary from one maker to the next, so read the ingredient list and brew it like its base tea.
processing: A dark base tea flavoured or scented by the maker; the recipe varies.
harvest_season: The base tea can come from any picking, so the season matters less than the recipe.
appearance_dry: Usually dark leaf, loose or pressed into bricks or baskets.
appearance_wet: Usually coarse dark leaf with some stem.
taste_profile: The mellow body of dark tea with the sweet scent of osmanthus.
vintage_note: Flavoured and scented teas are not sold by vintage. Buy recent stock and drink it within a year or so, since the aroma fades.
